source:
@@U04639@@
And you, you flailing, gangly buffoons, keep your arms astir over the body, so if it escapes you'll catch it in your claws. I suspect it’s growing tired of its old quarters, and spirits always seek the upward path.

@@U04640@@
(A glory is lowered from above right in a burst of light.)

@@U04642@@
Kin to the blest above, Envoys of heavenly love, Follow in flight: Sinners forgiving Bounteous giving To all things living, A trace of delight!

@@U04644@@
Ah! These jarring, jangling discords! Sounds, terrible, falling from the sky, unwelcome, ah! unwelcome as that hated light! Androgynous bungling! Boyish-girlish pranks that only the godly can abide! You know how in the depths of black depravity we planned the annihilation of the human race? Well, in creating the gravest of all sins, we found that they were welcome in their worship. Hypocrites! Mincing milksops! They rob our prey using our own weapons! Devils, they're devils, too, the same as us! Ah, but disguised! If they get the better of you, you never live it down! Stand fast at the grave! Hold it against all odds!
translation:
@@U04639@@
而你，你们这些挥舞着的、瘦长的小丑，用你的手臂在尸体上搅动，这样，如果它逃跑了，你就会用爪子抓住它。我怀疑它已经厌倦了它的老地方，而灵魂总是在寻找向上的道路。

@@U04640@@
（一道光辉从右上方降下。）

@@U04642@@
至高无上的亲人，天堂之爱的使者，跟随在飞行中：宽恕的罪人慷慨的给予众生，一丝喜悦！

@@U04644@@
啊！这些刺耳的、刺耳的不和谐声！声音，可怕，从天而降，不受欢迎啊！不受欢迎，就像那讨厌的光一样！雌雄同体的笨拙！只有虔诚的人才能忍受的男孩女孩恶作剧！你知道在黑暗堕落的深处我们是如何计划灭绝人类的吗？好吧，在创造了最严重的罪恶时，我们发现他们的崇拜受到欢迎。伪君子！切碎奶泡！他们用我们自己的武器抢劫我们的猎物！恶魔，他们也是恶魔，和我们一样！啊，不过是伪装的！如果他们战胜了你，你就永远不会失望！坟墓前要坚守！克服一切困难坚持下去！
